issue.body:
will it be possible to get multiple folder to deliver static content ? 

eg 

```
app = Router(routes=[
    Mount('/static', app=StaticFiles(directory=['static', '/home/foxmask/static'], packages=['bootstrap4']), name="static"),
])
```
this will allow to avoid 

```
app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory="/home/foxmask/static/"))  # use to delivery files
app.mount('/static-css', StaticFiles(directory="static/css"))
app.mount('/static-js', StaticFiles(directory="static/js"))
```
issue.title: multiple static folders
